## A N   A C T

## RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

location.provenance: ## S TATE   OF     R H O D E     IS L A N D

status.provenance: It is enacted by the General Assembly as follows:

date.provenance: (d) Effective January 1, 2024, no food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.

pfas_definition.provenance: (l) "Perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl  substances" or "PFAS" means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

value: "Incidental presence" means the presence of a regulated metal as an unintended or undesired ingredient of a package or packaging component.
